buildScope: Owner-only unpublished app/flow build using existing validation Status. Culture extension is prepared, not live. Separate participation/openness filters, trusted ordinary-caller binding, field projection and full acceptance remain gates before ordinary rollout.

inputContract.My_profile: Compose: server-loaded profile; owner-only construction. App-supplied item ID is a reference, not authorization.

profileShape.accountId: canonical Person Claims from stored profile, never app email
profileShape.displayName: stored Person DisplayName for owner preview
profileShape.status: validation Status choice Value; participation status is separate pending #6
profileShape.teachIds: array of integer Language catalogue IDs
profileShape.learnIds: array of integer Language catalogue IDs
profileShape.shareCultureIds: array of integer Culture catalogue IDs
profileShape.learnCultureIds: array of integer Culture catalogue IDs

completionGates: Bind authenticated caller before sharing with ordinary users; owner-only construction is not an authorization solution.
Implement separate participation/openness filters after #6 fields are bound; missing target fields must not imply availability.
Agree final response fields with #42 before wider exposure.
Verify actual lookup ID-array fields, pagination and synchronous response bounds; fail clearly on incomplete data.
Complete deferred test cases and do not close #7 on preparation artifacts.
